landing_meta_description: Save your surf spots with the swell, wind and tide that make them work. Tonnr reads the buoys and the forecasts, and shows you when they line up.
landing_hero_body: Save a spot with the swell, wind and tide that make it work. Tonnr reads the buoys and the forecasts, and shows you when they line up.
landing_spots_body: A spot is a point on the map and the conditions you trust: swell height, period and direction, wind, and tide. Keep it private, make it public, or share it with chosen people.
landing_alerts_body: Tonnr checks every spot against live measurements and forecasts, and lists the windows when it should work.
landing_data_body: Wave buoys and wind stations from public networks, read continuously, each with its source and its license.
landing_open_body: The data behind the app is a public API. The code is open source under the AGPL, and you can host your own instance.
landing_footer_license: Free and open source, under the AGPL.
shortcuts_description: Select a shortcut, then press the new keys. Backspace turns it off.
shortcuts_incomplete: Add a key to the combination.
shortcuts_account_hint: Shortcuts belong to this device. Save them to your account to use the same ones elsewhere.
shortcuts_account_error: Your account could not be reached.
